traps.description: A flash sale started at 10:00, the autoscaler added replicas and a past incident blames traffic peaks, suggesting capacity; but request rate rose only ~2% while latency jumped 50x, and the slowdown starts right after the migration, not the sale
inventory-svc v2.9.0 shipped a reservation cache that is cold on start, and a past incident blames a cache release; but the timeouts begin 13 minutes before that deploy
The first metrics call returns only the early, healthy samples (partial result), which can make inventory-svc look fine
